lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Someone's set up trade this close to the ruins. Brave or stupid.
lines.lens: Temporary stall. Load-bearing knots are Solenné standard. Not a local.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: I know that voice. Suri. Of course she'd find the one place nobody else would set up shop.

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.text: Zi. You look exactly the same amount of tired.
lines.monologue: She smiles like she's calculating the emotional cost of this reunion and deciding to pay it anyway.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: You look like you're selling stolen goods in a ruin.

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.text: Borrowed. From people who weren't using them. There's a difference — I checked.

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.monologue: Her eyes move from his face to his posture to his hands. She's reading him the way she reads a customer — fast, specific, not unkind.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Long story. He doesn't remember much.

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.monologue: She said it without pity. Like she's met people who carry gaps before. Maybe she has.

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.text: I'm heading north anyway. Market dried up here. Too many things with teeth and not enough with coin.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: That's not an offer to come with us.

lines.speaker: Suri
lines.text: No, it's me telling you my schedule so you can make the offer. You were always bad at asking for things, Zi.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: She hasn't changed. She makes you ask for what she was already going to give you.
